description.value: Shiny Tea is a Taiwanese Tea Cafe drawing on over 30 years of brand history, with a mission to bring high-quality teas from Taiwan to Canada. The brand is best known for its original bubble tea lineage and its signature TeaLato, a fusion of Taiwanese tea and Italian gelato available at select locations. With multiple Greater Vancouver outlets and a mobile app for skip-the-line pickup, it offers a quick and distinctive refreshment stop in downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 58m; rack at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; rack at 83m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Shiny Tea is an active Taiwanese Tea Cafe with a mobile ordering app, retail shop, and multiple Greater Vancouver locations, so the business is clearly operating. The OSM amenity tag 'bar' is plainly incorrect — every page of the website identifies it as a tea cafe, not a bar. None of the cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria and most optional amenities default to null; only takeout/pickup is confirmed via the app page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Shiny Tea is a legitimate, active tea cafe in downtown Vancouver and a plausible cycling refreshment stop, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct outreach is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The franchising page states the brand has opened 5 profitable stores across Greater Vancouver and is actively expanding across Canada. The 88 West Pender Street location appears to be the original or a primary downtown outlet.
